header: The webconsulting TYPO3 lab in 60 seconds
description: Everything in this lab in one film: website tools, AI tools, four software products, ten website templates and our strategy for agents on the web. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 60 seconds: everything in the webconsulting TYPO3 v14 lab. 17 website tools, 11 AI tools with people in charge, four software products (T3 Ops, Ledger, MedAtlas Austria, CapexOne Plus), ten website templates and the strategy for agents on the web. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: One TYPO3 installation shows everything we build.
The webconsulting lab in one film.
Seventeen website tools: design systems, blog and news, editing on the page, search, forms and sign-in.
Eleven AI tools, with people in charge: an assistant, skills, MCP and agent protocols.
T3 Ops runs the fleet, Ledger closes the month, MedAtlas tracks medicine shortages, CapexOne Plus governs capital projects.
Ten website templates, each a live demo site.
And a strategy for agents on the web.
Download the whole lab and run it on your laptop.
